reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 76,200.0. The level is placed 61.0 points BELOW the session low of 76,261.0 and below the lower edge of the 76,125-76,375 bucket that has absorbed 713,318 USD of long liquidations in the last six hours, so the gate cannot be run and un-run by the flow that is already printing. Distance from spot is 595.3 points, 1.28 hourly ATRs on a 463.38 reading. This is the third consecutive session in which the settled-close requirement is the binding constraint rather than the level: overnight, price traded 339.0 points THROUGH the midnight gate at 76,600.0 and no 1H bar has yet settled below it. That is a feature, not a bug - it kept the desk out of the 76,261.0 wick - but it means the gate is a decision rule, not protection. The resting stop is the protection and it sits at a different price on purpose.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,450.0. That is the 1H EMA20 at 77,379.75 plus a 70.25-point buffer, deliberately 0.15 of one hourly ATR, because the single most expensive mistake of the last twelve hours was treating a 2.5-point EMA20 reclaim as confirmation. The 06:00Z hour settled 77,612.8 against an EMA20 of 77,610.3, midnight called the short thesis dead on that margin, and price then lost 1,351.8 points. A reclaim that cannot clear the average by a fifteenth of an ATR is noise. 77,450.0 also sits above the 15m EMA50 at 77,175.30 and inside the 77,250 bucket where 233,484 USD of longs were liquidated on the way down.

decisionBox.changed: Everything the midnight report leaned on has reversed. Midnight was range with a bearish tilt at 5.0 confidence on the strength of a reclaimed 1H EMA20, a positive 1H MACD histogram at +61.47, a higher low at 76,713.6 and easing funding. Four hours later the EMA20 is lost by 584.5 points, the 1H MACD histogram is back to -37.23, the 76,713.6 low is broken by 452.6 points, and funding has RISEN from 0.0000744604525652 to 0.0001000000000000 while price fell. The stance moves from HOLD-and-watch to HOLD-the-core-and-hedge: the spot book is untouched because the daily trend is intact, but the swing operation flips from wait to short and the reduce gate drops 400 points from 76,600.0 to 76,200.0 to sit under the live flow.

liquidation.note: 1,184,575 USD across 161 filled orders, every single one of them a SELL - a long liquidation, a forced sell - inside the 76,375-76,625 bucket. It is the largest cluster in the six-hour window by a factor of 1.66 and it sits 295.3 points BELOW spot. This is realized flow, not a forward resting-order heatmap: it marks where longs have ALREADY been carried out, which makes it a shelf that has been thinned rather than a wall.

713,318 USD across 111 fills, all of them long liquidations, inside the 76,125-76,375 bucket. This is the 76,261.0 session low being made. It is 545.3 points below spot and it is the next shelf if the 76,500 cluster gives way. The reduce gate at 76,200.0 is set below its lower edge on purpose.

679,130 USD across 118 fills, all long liquidations, inside the 76,875-77,125 bucket - the level being defended on the way down, now 204.7 points ABOVE spot. Because the fills here were forced SELLS, this is overhead supply that has already been cleared out, so it is a softer ceiling than its size suggests.

668,133 USD across 81 fills, 69 sells and 12 buys, inside the 76,625-76,875 bucket. Spot at 76,795.3 is sitting INSIDE this bucket right now. It is the only bucket in the window with meaningful two-way liquidation, which is what a level looks like while it is still being fought over.

Accounts are net-adding longs into a decline and paying more to do it. That is the fuel the 76,500 and 76,250 shelves feed on.

calibration.rollingRecord: MIDNIGHT GRADED: THE GATE WAS RIGHT AND THE DISCRETIONARY EXIT WAS WRONG. Midnight set the reduce gate at 76,600.0 with price at 77,745.4 and required a settled 1H close. Price traded to 76,261.0, 339.0 points THROUGH the level, and no hourly bar has settled below it - the lowest settled 1H close is 76,683.2. The gate is UNFIRED and, on a pure price basis, correctly so: spot at this report is 76,795.3, so a desk that sold on the 76,261.0 wick would be 534.3 points behind. That is now three consecutive sessions in which the settled-close requirement kept the desk out of a violation, and the running lesson stands. What did NOT work was the discretionary futures exit. Midnight closed the inherited 70 USDT short at 77,745.4, booking -0.43 USDT, on the grounds that a 2.5-point settled reclaim of the 1H EMA20 met the kill condition endday had written. Price then fell 1,351.8 points to 76,261.0. Held to its 76,420.0 first target the position would have returned roughly +1.20 USDT instead. The error was not the rule, it was the tolerance: a confirmation satisfied by 2.5 points on a tape whose hourly ATR is 463.38 is noise dressed as signal. Every gate in this report now carries an explicit buffer sized in ATRs. The add gate at 77,450.0 is the 1H EMA20 plus 0.15 ATR for exactly that reason. The midnight add gate at 77,950.0 was also correctly unfired against a session high of 77,636.1, 313.9 points short, and the invalidation at 75,559.5 was never approached.
calibration.note: priorReduceFired is False on the settled-close definition the gate was written under. Recorded honestly: on a touch definition it would be True, and the gap between the two - 339.0 points - is the third such gap in three sessions. actingHelped is null because neither midnight gate armed; the graded decision this session is the discretionary exit, and that one lost money.
